A.claim: No counterexample to Beal's conjecture exists with A, B <= 160000 and exponents x, y, z in {3,5,7,11,13,17,19}.

B.claim: Classical Fermat descent on the all-even branch sends signature (2r,2s,2t) to signature (2r,2r,t) with coefficient 2 - it diagonalises the left exponents, halves the right one, and introduces a 2. It is therefore NOT a self-map of a single equation, so infinite descent cannot close. The number of available steps is exactly v_2(t).
